questions.question: Calculate 15% of 640 in two different ways.
240 of 640 learners walk to school. What percentage is this? Show your working.
Increase 640 by 25%, then decrease the result by 25%. Explain why you do not get back to 640.
questions.expected_answer: 640 + 160 = 800; 25% of 800 = 200, so 800 − 200 = 600. The decrease is a percentage of the larger amount 800, so more is taken off than was added.
